text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Seiun Sky! Leg 1 of the 
Classic Triple Crown, the battle of the 
Big Three! The one to claim it is Seiun 
Sky-!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Alright!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that surprised me. I didn't know you 
did fist pumps...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Eeeek. Peeping is so perverted. King of 
perverts.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Dummy! Of course you'd look at the 
winner!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*. Congratulations, Sky-san. 
However, this will be the last time I 
applaud for you."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because for the next Japan Derby, it'll be 
your turn to celebrate me!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Who knows? There is one other strong 
candidate, after all~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I forgot to mention. Thanks for the 
applause, pervert King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Stop calling me by that disgraceful 
nickname this instant!!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san~. Sei-chan went and won☆ 
Peace.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hello, hello~. Man, I really didn't expect 
to take the first crown.
choice_data_list:
Let's keep this up and claim our second 
crown!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ooh☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'd really love to ride this high, but..." 
, {"id": 9, "en": "Just as I was about to 
give upâ

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Seems like he's still not quite ready to 
let me ride him, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Seiun Sky murmured that, her sidelong 
glance drifted toward—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week stood there, gazing at Seiun 
Sky with eyes full of fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And on the way home from the racetrack...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sei-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hey, there's something I want to tell 
Sei-chan.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh-ho, is that a declaration of war? Did 
King's little habit rub off on you~?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, this is... a declaration of war.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, congratulations on today! Sei-chan, 
you really are strong after all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Still... in the upcoming Japan Derby, I 
absolutely refuse to lose."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...For the sake of my dream.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I want to win the Derby and become 
the best Umamusume in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm taking the Derby! I'll get 
stronger, much stronger—I swear!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...A dream, huh.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan is really going to get stronger 
and stronger, isn't she? She's the 
protagonist type who turns dreams and 
feelings into power, after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Watching you... honestly makes me want 
your wish to come true.
choice_data_list:
But if you do that, your dream won't come 
true.

But if you do that, your dream won't come 
true.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I don't plan on letting you 
win, you know? Still, having such a 
dazzling dream like that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bzzzzzzzt)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...A phone call.
choice_data_list: You can enter if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ... Hello?

text_block_list.name: Caller
text_block_list.text: "Skyyy! Congratulations!!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, Grandpa! Keep your voice down!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky hurriedly backed away. Even from 
a distance, though, it was clear how 
overjoyed the person on the other end of 
the call was.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly~. They were rejoicing as if 
they'd won the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Grandpa. Well, I get why you're so 
happy, though.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It seemed like it was Grandpa's dream to 
see me win a Classic race.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I've heard that so many times ever 
since I was little!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Talking to an innocent little filly, 
spewing big dreams like, "You've got what 
it takes to win the Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess they won't bite unless I get 
serious~. Maybe I'll try putting in some 
effort...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I recalled the rare moment she spoke with 
utter seriousness. It seemed her 
grandfather's dream was also part of why 
she wanted to challenge the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I'm doing this thinking, 
'I'll win for Grandpa!' ...or anything 
like that, okay?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm really glad I made it in time, though. 
You know, Gramps is getting pretty up 
there in age, after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm just glad... I could show them me 
running on the stage of my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky narrows her eyes with a gentle 
expression. But soon enough—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, I won't get my reward for 
winning the Classics, right? ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well... that's why I run completely and 
utterly for my own sake.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Unlike Spe-chan and everyone else... I 
just don't have some grand dream or noble 
reason, you know?
choice_data_list:
No one's desire to win is superior to 
another's.

No one's desire to win is superior to 
another's.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that may be true, but you sure 
don't mince words.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, but... yeah, who cares? Someone lazy 
like me—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"—Even if we go and take the 'Japanese 
Derby'!"
